versions.content: Independent event memories for multiple diagnostic server in- stances (virtual ECUs) Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall provide multiple sets of independent event memories that can store information independently from each other. Rationale: Individual assignment of fault memories to dedicated diagnostic servers. ▽ 54 of 75 Document ID 4: AUTOSAR_FO_RS_Diagnostics Requirements on Diagnostics AUTOSAR FO R25-11 △ Use Case: ECUs with multiple independent diagnostic servers. Common faults of the host ECU shall be stored in each of the virtual ECU which is affected by such a fault. Common faults need to be stored in each virtual ECU to ensure that storing and clearing of fault entries has no or little side-effects with the information stored in other virtual ECUs. This use-case assumes that the cost to store a common fault in multiple event memory entries is accepted because sharing of a single event memory entry may have unintended side-effects.
